name: I'm Helping. You're Welcome.
title: Christmas – French Bulldog I'm Helping. You're Welcome. Mug
story: I'm helping, you're welcome: a Frenchie mug for anyone who has wrapped a present around a French Bulldog sitting on the paper. It makes an easy Christmas morning coffee gift or stocking stuffer for the Frenchie owner who has lost a roll of tape to a helper.

The print is a brindle French Bulldog with big upright bat ears and a strip of tape stuck to one ear, sitting proudly on half-unrolled red-and-cream striped wrapping paper with a curly green ribbon tangled around its front leg, a paper roll, a pair of scissors and a few green bows beside it. I'M HELPING. runs above the dog in deep red capitals and YOU'RE WELCOME. below it in pine green, big enough to read across the kitchen table, on bright white glossy ceramic.
It matches our I'm Helping. You're Welcome. Frenchie tee, so the mug and the shirt make a set for the same helper's person. Fill it with coffee, cocoa or cider while the dog supervises the wrapping.
joke_a: When a French Bulldog sits on the wrapping paper with tape stuck to one ear and calls it helping, the only reply is you're welcome. The I'm Helping. You're Welcome. Frenchie mug from Graphic Tees Co. puts that proud brindle helper on a white mug, so every Frenchie owner gets the joke with each sip.
source: I'm Helping. You're Welcome. Frenchie tee
